conclusions: The file panel toggle changes only navigation flag/persisted layout preference.
TaskView is a keepMounted sibling of conditional file panel; existing terminals use stable ptyId keys. Terminal mount effect depends on taskId/ptyId, not panel visibility.
Panel mount/unmount attaches/detaches watch consumers; store and buffers are cached by file scope and not disposed on panel hide.
Text editor unmount captures scrollTop; its authoritative EditorState remains on the cached buffer.
Terminal resize returns without emitting a 0x0 geometry when its host is hidden.
evidenceNeeded: Root actual 20 show/hide cycles with same file routes/active/root/expanded/cursor/scroll as applicable.
Actual fixed ptyId/PID and monotonic heartbeat output, no new task or task exit.
sourceReview.layerAssessment: Actual packaged UI operations exercising real file services plus PTY logs may support both I and A. A mock PTY attach-loop test would not add equivalent proof and is not required by this I+A case.

observedRequired: same unique heartbeat run / one START across the entire action interval
same process PID with continuous monotonically increasing heartbeat numbers
fresh terminal input before and after the sequence is echoed by that same heartbeat process
ptyIdentityInference.codeInvariant: PtyManager generates an id only when spawning a new node-pty process. It has no API to reassign an existing process to a new id. The login wrapper execs the runner, preserving the process PID. TaskService retains the live task->pty association; panel toggle does not call create/resume/kill.
ptyIdentityInference.conclusionIfObservationsHold: Same PTY instance and unchanged ptyId inferred from observed process continuity plus the exact packaged source invariant; UUID value itself was not directly read.
ptyIdentityInference.limit: Same PID alone is insufficient because of potential PID reuse. Do not label an unobserved UUID as measured; keep the inference and actual output evidence explicit.
